raw: “I felt really proud when a kite I’d made finally stayed up in the air. I was out by the dunes, and I’d made it a longer tail cut from an old sheet. What I remember most is watching it stay up and realizing it wasn’t coming straight back down. It stayed above the dunes for ten minutes. I’d made the thing myself, so seeing it actually fly was a lovely feeling. I just wanted to keep watching it.”
